description: Zip around on the lake with our most mobile boating option!
check_in_details: If you need delivery for your rental please contact us to set that up for you!
faqs:
Q: Do you require a damage deposit
A: Yes we do require a $400 damage deposit per jet ski

Q: When will we receive a refund of the damage deposit
A: We require a full 24 hours after your rental period is over to inspect the jet ski for any damages.

Q: Are life jackets included
A: Yes all safety equipment is included!
